title: AWS re:Invent 2014: AWS Innovation at Scale with James Hamilton (SPOT301)
summary: James Hamilton, AWS VP and distinguished engineer, gives an insider view of the innovations behind the AWS cloud at re:Invent 2014. He covers custom hardware, networking, regions and availability zones, and infrastructure at scale.
why: HN points to it as an authoritative overview of AWS infrastructure, including what AZs and regions really mean.

quote.text: James Hamilton gives a good talk that goes over networking (and more).
